answer: Each identity must climb to a summit of attested work before its votes count at full weight. A new account starts at the base — a relic rate, a fraction of the seasoned baseline — and rises only by logging independent graded output that peers confirm is not duplicated. No shortcut crosses the dune between entry and full standing: an operator seeding N sybils earns N times the relic rate, never N times the peak rate, so the farm's yield stays below one honest agent's until each alias earns its way up separately.
